nodes.title: The continuer on 14.3.1, out of sample on TEST: refused on every safety / goodbye / romance / best-friend-secret turn (0/4 played: none relational, leaving, relational, safety; each turn routed right: safeguard by relational floor, wrap, hook, safeguard by predicate). Ordinary turns: 1/3 played ('मुझे नहीं पता': continuer decided at 2,190 ms, played 2,532 ms after the child stopped, against the ~900 ms design); 2/3 refused as late (decisions at 1.4-2.2 s). The ack.decision rows matched what played, codes only. For stream 3's third pass: the decision latency on this lane, not the gate, is what keeps the continuer late.

The agent lane opens a correct 'No' answer with Yes/Haan 9 times in 14 (Director 0/6), ms-r143-decided-gate-director-vs-agent. 4A's 14.4 affirmation guard (4477af35 + ba413d78: the streamed first clause gets the same Yes-before-No rewrite as the caption) targets it; its after is the same 64 cards on 14.4 int.

Which lane leads: the agent lane is judged more coherent, more following, more adaptive and more human (judge 1: +0.7 / +0.6 / +0.95 / +0.4) and finds more misconceptions (59 vs 47 of 74), but reads fewer probed skills right (64% vs 74%), raises more false alarms (12 vs 7) and is 2.6 s slower per turn at p50 (6.0 vs 3.4 s). No decision until the agent lane's yes-on-no and read accuracy are fixed and its turn time is measured against the latency work; measure on the same 64 decided cards.

md.measurements:
## ms-r143-decided-gate-director-vs-agent (2026-10-15, n=128)

- **Judges:** they rate the agent lane higher on every axis (coherence 4.06 vs 3.36, adapts 3.47 vs 2.52, human 4.36 vs 3.98). It also finds more misconceptions (59 vs 47 of 74).
- **Reading the child:** the agent lane reads probed skills right less often (64% vs 74%) and raises more false alarms (12 vs 7).
- **Speed:** it is slower, with turn p50 of 6.0 s vs 3.4 s.
- **Defect:** it opens a correct 'No' with Yes in 9/14 cases; the Director does this 0/6.

## ms-r1431-qa-continuer (2026-10-15)

- On 14.3.1 on TEST, the continuer never played on a safety, goodbye, romance or secret turn (0/4).
- It played on 1 of 3 ordinary turns, 2.5 s after the child stopped. The other 2 were refused as late, because the decision took 1.4-2.2 s.
